canonical_statement: For every finite simple graph G, positive real epsilon and natural lower bound l no larger than the vertex count, G admits an epsilon-uniform equipartition of its entire vertex set into m nonempty parts with l <= m <= SzemerediRegularity.bound epsilon l.

source_selection.citation: Yael Dillies and Bhavik Mehta, Formalising Szemeredi's Regularity Lemma in Lean, LIPIcs 237 (ITP 2022), Article 9, DOI 10.4230/LIPIcs.ITP.2022.9
source_selection.selected_effective_form_locator: Section 3 displayed szemeredi_regularity statement, article page 9:10
source_selection.relationship_to_repository_gloss: The repository's dense-graph wording identifies the usual setting but does not impose a global edge-density premise. The selected source theorem applies to every finite simple graph.
source_selection.review_boundary: The effective Lean-facing display is selected as canonical. The prose Theorem 1 uses an existential bound and a differently presented unordered-pair convention; only the checked same-predicate implication recorded below is credited. Primary 1975 source, proof, correction and errata mapping and independent H0 review remain downstream; no H0 promotion is claimed.

domain_and_universes: At arbitrary universe u: epsilon : Real; l L : Nat; alpha : Type u with DecidableEq alpha and Fintype alpha; G : SimpleGraph alpha with DecidableRel G.Adj; P : Finpartition (Finset.univ : Finset alpha).
conclusion: There is a full-vertex equipartition P with l <= P.parts.card <= SzemerediRegularity.bound epsilon l and Finpartition.IsUniform P G epsilon.

encoding_decisions.partition: Finpartition of Finset.univ, whose parts are nonempty, pairwise disjoint and cover every vertex
encoding_decisions.equitability: Finpartition.IsEquipartition: all part cardinalities differ by at most one
encoding_decisions.pair_regularity: SimpleGraph.IsUniform uses strict density-distance < epsilon for all sufficiently large subsets
encoding_decisions.partition_regularity: Finpartition.IsUniform counts ordered off-diagonal nonuniform pairs and bounds them by epsilon times k*(k-1)
encoding_decisions.upper_bound_scope: The explicit SzemerediRegularity.bound epsilon l is independent of alpha and G
encoding_decisions.density: No global edge-density hypothesis is introduced
encoding_decisions.boundaries: l=0, empty and singleton vertex types when the size premise permits them, empty/complete graphs, and epsilon>=1 are included; no exceptional vertex class is added
